lead.headline: QM SURGES TO #1 ON GITHUB
lead.deck: YC-Software's QM repository is surging in popularity, adding over 2,400 stars in a single day
lead.body: The project, a multiplayer agent harness for work, is drawing attention from developers and industry professionals alike as it rapidly gains traction on GitHub. With its growing user base and impressive star count, QM is poised to become a go-to solution for teams looking to streamline collaboration and optimize workflow. The project's focus on multiplayer functionality and agent harness capabilities suggests a high level of sophistication and potential for scalability, making it an attractive option for organizations seeking to improve productivity and efficiency. As the project continues to gain momentum, it will be interesting to see how QM evolves and is adopted by the development community
